assumptions: Static action means exclude accuracy, critical hits, armor, shields, secondary statuses, cooldown opportunity cost, and target availability.
Set collection counts equipment drops only, excludes duplicate definitions, and uses possession as an upper bound on wearable thresholds. Combat also awards skills.
Uniform-catalog is a diagnostic comparison. Fixed-base scenarios reproduce repeated rarity upgrades but omit distance progression and equipped luck changes.
Zero observed events are not proof of impossibility; the report includes the rule-of-three approximate 95% upper bound.
Full-outfit stats use the guardian as a fixed reference and include cumulative 2/4/6-piece bonuses with intact anatomy.

normal.name: Легкая
normal.description: Стандартная сила врагов и частота опасных встреч.

hard.name: Нормальная
hard.description: Враги крепче, наносят больше урона; опасные группы встречаются чаще.

nightmare.name: Сложная
nightmare.description: Самые стойкие и опасные враги, больше эпических групп и мини-боссов.

scaling.note: Party damage scaling multiplies enemy power, not the flat dice portion. Difficulty damage scaling multiplies direct and ordinary status damage, excluding fixed decay damage.

rarity.rule: Each rarity step succeeds when d20 >= 20 - luck; repeat until failure or legendary.
